prompt: Please summarize the Galatians 6:14 from the bible
response:
Galatians 6:14 from the Bible reads: "But may it never be that I should boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world."

This verse emphasizes the transformative power of the cross of Jesus Christ. It suggests that the crucifixion of Jesus is the only thing the speaker (Paul) finds worthy of boasting about. It also indicates that through the cross, the speaker has become detached from the values and concerns of the world, and the world has become irrelevant to him. This highlights the central role of the cross in Christian faith and the radical change it brings to one's perspective and priorities.
